# Load 
```{R}
library(naniar)
library(tidyverse)
```

# How ggplot displays missing values.
```{R}
ggplot(oceanbuoys,
       aes(x = sea_temp_c,
           y = humidity)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x = "Sea temperature (celcius)",
       y = "Humidity")

# Warning: “Removed 94 rows containing missing values”
```

# Adding missing value to plot
```{R}
ggplot(oceanbuoys,
       aes(x = sea_temp_c,
           y = humidity)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  geom_miss_point() + 
  labs(x = "Sea temperature (celcius)",
       y = "Humidity")
```
# Adding missing value to plot by year
```{R}
ggplot(oceanbuoys,
       aes(x = sea_temp_c,
           y = humidity)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  geom_miss_point() + 
  labs(x = "Sea temperature (celcius)",
       y = "Humidity")
```

```{R}
ggplot(oceanbuoys,
       aes(x = sea_temp_c,
           y = air_temp_c)) + 
  geom_miss_point() + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(x = "Sea temperature (celcius)",
       y = "Air temperature (celcius)")
```

# Shadow matrix
```{R}
as_shadow(oceanbuoys)

oceanbuoys_shadow <- bind_shadow(oceanbuoys)

glimpse(oceanbuoys_shadow)
```

# Relationship with other variable 
```{R}
ggplot(oceanbuoys_shadow,
       aes(x = wind_ew,
           y = wind_ns,
           colour = air_temp_c_NA)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  labs(x = "East-West Winds",
       y = "North-South Winds") 
```
